### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, touching **23** documentable anchor(s).

**44** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8925d5bcb1a96beb59ff6ae35fada6f69f4f893d`.

⛔ **11** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** cross-cutting symbol(s) contributed no route anchor: `userId (5 routes)`
- **6** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **67** of **249** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **21** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8925d5bcb1a96beb59ff6ae35fada6f69f4f893d` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `d99e5f698cc7ae90329218ff51b4e99e8a3ff2cf` — the merge of head `c1e7347cc1f83830d9bfe3e49957d2d97755c7db` into base `8925d5bcb1a96beb59ff6ae35fada6f69f4f893d`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin d99e5f698cc7ae90329218ff51b4e99e8a3ff2cf && git checkout d99e5f698cc7ae90329218ff51b4e99e8a3ff2cf
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 8925d5bcb1a96beb59ff6ae35fada6f69f4f893d c1e7347cc1f83830d9bfe3e49957d2d97755c7db && git checkout -B drift-repro 8925d5bcb1a96beb59ff6ae35fada6f69f4f893d && git merge --no-ff c1e7347cc1f83830d9bfe3e49957d2d97755c7db

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8925d5bcb1a96beb59ff6ae35fada6f69f4f893d
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 8925d5bcb1a96beb59ff6ae35fada6f69f4f893d` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对 — REWORK · head c1e7347cc1f83830d9bfe3e49957d2d97755c7db

This record is not the full verdict. One further item has gone to the seat, and the PR waits on the seat's answer as well as on the items below. No code change is asked for here.

### To fix (body)

1. **The `Skills-docs:` line is missing.** The body carries `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, so the line is owed (`l1-face`: "owed … and absent — REWORK").
   - Add it, true at this head: `none` with its reason, or `follow-up #N`.
   - For the reason, `skills/**` mentions the development seed only as `os dev --seed-admin` (`skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md`). No skill states what a production boot does to a seeded account's credentials. Check that yourself before you write `none`.
2. **Acceptance notes, the `.changeset/dev-seed-credential-production-refusal.md` line.** It says that note is not amended ("amending it is outside this card's file surface and is raised in the report"). The `## DELIBERATE CORRECTION` section and the diff at this head amend it, so the line is false. Drop it, or point it at the correction section.
3. **Acceptance notes, the "Revoke reason" line.** It ends "raised in the report", with no `#N`. The `## Revoke reason` section below it names follow-up #36313, so cite `#36313` on that line too.

A body edit re-runs the PR-body guards. Tell me when they are green, and I will read the body alone. The further item is the seat's.

### Checked and holding

- **Shape:** at c1e7347cc1, 40 success, 17 expected skip, and `Check Changeset` red in both runs for the DELIBERATE CORRECTION alone.
  - `Fixes #35184`. The declarations are `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` · `Metadata-protocol: none`. The changeset is a patch on `@objectstack/plugin-auth` with `!`, the BREAKING section first, and ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.
  - The delta from 9461451a9d is that one changeset line (`git diff --stat`: 1 file, +1/−1). So the dogfood battery on 9461451a9d (484 files passed, 0 failed) and the suites and ablations on the earlier heads stand for this head.
- **The DELIBERATE CORRECTION** (`.changeset/dev-seed-credential-production-refusal.md`, the last paragraph): both the label and the last sentence are quoted before and after.
  - "a boot outside development mode also retires them" is true at this head for the accounts that paragraph speaks of, a seeded account "still on it".
  - The quoted title is a verbatim prefix of the new note's first line.
  - This PR changes code, so under `landing-operations.md` the correction is confirmed by the seat's same-head, at-tier L2 PASS, which judges the two sentences, not by this record.
- **Wiring (`auth-plugin.ts`):** there is one `kernel:ready` hook, registered apart from `registerRoutes`. It resolves `objectql`, and a missing engine means no stamped account. It awaits `retireDevSeedCredentials`, which returns at once under `isDevelopmentMode()`.
- **Pins and ablations:** 6 real-engine cases (SQLite file, two boots per case). There are 7 ablation legs, one per wiring point, and each turns its case red. Each restore was proven against HEAD.
  - The file reads 9.98 s locally, against the 10 s line, as the body says.
- **Gates:** `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` were NOT MEASURED locally, and `check:type-check-debt` was UNRUN, its one reading discarded. All three are carried by green `Lint & Repo Gates` at this head.
- **Docs:** `self-hosting.mdx` now states the rule in timeless wording and drops the card-number phrasing. The changeset's FROM/TO and its "Not moved" list match the code paths read.
- **Landing:** this is narrowing, so it goes to the seat and then the maintainer. It enters the queue red under SKILL.md's three conditions.
